$comment: Suppress known/reviewed failures from the flaky-test report. Each entry silences a specific test identified by file + context + it title. Suppressed tests appear in a collapsed section at the bottom of the report instead of polluting the actionable sections.

suppressions.it: Audits.Filters.RetrieveAllAudits.GET: Then returns only audits scheduled for today
suppressions.context: Audits.Filters: Given Audit Types, Audit Rounds, Templates and Audits are created > Audits.Filters.RetrieveAllAudits.GET: When filtering with fromDate and toDate both set to today

suppressions.it: SettingActionPriority.Group.Get.GET: Then return all Action Priorities with 200 status code
suppressions.context: SettingActionPriority: Given the user needs to manage action priorities > SettingActionPriority.Group.Get.GET: When group user gets all Action Priorities

suppressions.it: Scoring.Basic.GET: Then return a 200 status code and audit score data in body
suppressions.context: Scoring: Given Audit round, Audit type, Template with Basic scoring, Sections, Questions, Audit are created > Scoring.Basic.GET: When the audit has NA answer for Checkbox question
